turns.text: Hello! How can I assist you today?
Can I upgrade my operating system? What are the system requirements?

Yes—there is KB information for Mac OS X and Windows 8.x upgrade requirements. For example, many Mac upgrades require 2GB memory, OS X v10.6.8 or later, and 8GB–64GB free space depending on version; Windows 8.x generally requires at least a 1 GHz processor, 1–2 GB RAM, and 16–20 GB free space.
Are you satisfied with the agent's response?
Glad to hear that! If you need anything else, feel free to ask.
You're welcome! How can I assist you today?
